confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on aggregated cost-of-living sites found by web search: expatexchange, CityCost, Traveltables and Expatistan. These give an inexpensive meal of about JPY 700-1,000, a mid-range meal for two of about JPY 3,000-5,551, a cappuccino of about JPY 300-526 and domestic draft beer of about JPY 400-600. Some of these sources are dated (Traveltables is from 2023), and Expatistan's beer price comes from only one data point. I raised the figures slightly for inflation up to July 2026 and converted them at an assumed rate of about JPY 150 per USD. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. Those two are estimates from the local price relationship to beer and general knowledge of Japanese izakaya and bar pricing (about JPY 700-1,000 for a cocktail and JPY 600-900 for a glass of house wine), so they are less certain. The accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against any searches or listings. Kanazawa has strong tourist demand, and July pricing could push hotel rates higher than these figures. I used the RBA figure of 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 Nov 2026 because it was the confirmed 4pm rate. A search result mentioned a figure for 19 Nov 2026 that I could not confirm as final.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kanazawa is a popular regional tourist city in Japan and sits between Tokyo and smaller regional cities on price. Cost-of-living sources put it about 10% below the Japanese average for everyday costs. I based hotel pricing on mid-sized tourist cities like Takayama and Matsumoto and areas of Kyoto outside the centre.
